summary: The manuscript reports a fully preregistered, artifact-backed paired evaluation comparing a verifier-augmented NetOps pipeline to an LLM-only pipeline on a compact action-aware staging benchmark. Execution and analysis artifacts are archived and reproduce the reported deterministic ceiling outcome (baseline = guarded = 400/400; paired difference = 0.0; permutation p = 1.0). Methodology, preregistration, and artifact provenance are well documented. Under closure review, two previously requested, artifact-resolvable manuscript fixes remain outstanding and must be addressed before finalisation.
required_revisions: Include an aggregated difficulty summary table (counts and percentages per difficulty level: medium / hard / very_hard) computed directly from execution/task_manifest.jsonl (the archived per-task difficulty labels). Place the table and a 1–2 sentence caption in Results (or an Appendix section inside pages 1–5). Report exact counts and percentages and reference the manifest artifact path or hash in the caption for auditors.

Replace the current placeholder reference to an 'archived verified bibliography' with explicit full bibliographic entries for the nearest prior works cited in Related Work (use the verified citation records already archived in the artifact bundle). Provide standard in-manuscript citations and a References list (IEEE style) containing those entries.
optional_revisions: Add the single-row execution accounting summary table (planned episodes, completed episodes, model_calls_used, complete_pairs, repairs_applied) drawn from analysis/condition_summary.csv to improve readability.

Briefly (1–2 sentences) state the pre-lock rationale for selecting shared_initial_generation and the single deterministic validator, or explicitly note that the choice was made to isolate validator acceptance on identical generator outputs, citing the preregistration artifact.

If space permits, include one representative worked example (one task manifest entry + validator_trace excerpt) to illustrate how a shared candidate accepted by the deterministic validator yields identical outcomes; use an archived example pair (e.g., task-000001) and include it compactly.
